protocol.calibration: The third-largest positive maximum from 56 ordinary GRID development H.264 deliveries sets each point with a fixed floor of 0.04. Require strict exceedance and native interval IoU of at least 0.50 for a correct edit location.
protocol.coverage_arm: On P pictures with exported vectors and at least 50% reference coverage, subtract target inter-prediction coverage from reference coverage. A missing vector describes exported coverage, not residual magnitude or the identity of the prediction mode.
protocol.dispersion_arm: Require at least half the sampled target and reference sites to have a vector and at least 12 covered samples per region. Remove the median reference vector and convert to eye-plane length. Subtract the reference median log(1+distance/0.5) from the target median.
protocol.gate: At least four correct strict LivePortrait intervals across three groups and the strict MuseTalk interval; at least 70% measured coverage in each strict neural family and the ordinary bank; at most two ordinary flags, none on untouched recordings, conventional recompressions or hard cuts.
protocol.held: Use the previous 34 matching H.264 neural and untouched deliveries, plus 34 source-matched non-neural local edits, 12 conventional temporal-processing controls, and 12 separate codec/cut controls. New control encodes use the same carrier settings. Every relative presentation timestamp must stay exact. Sources have prior project exposure.
protocol.range: One best interval of 8, 12, 16 or 20 pictures, with five-picture flanks. Same observed shot, at least 80% measured in the middle and both flanks. Score the smaller positive rise against both flanks. Reuse the exact native interval selection and crop policy of the brightness-conditioned study.
protocol.region: Classify global four-pixel block-center lattice samples using one native face geometry transform. Target mouth ellipse radii 19 and 12 in the eye plane. Reference ellipses at (-26,-12), (26,-12), and (0,-24) with radii (11,11), (11,11), (15,8). Require at least 12 target and reference lattice samples each.
protocol.source: One upright native H.264 file using I/P pictures only. H.264 encoder decisions, not decoded color residuals, optical flow, audio or a second file, supply the measured signal.
